item.title: Fearing Chinese Rivals, U.S. Biotech Adopts a New Norm: Share Nothing
item.description: Concerns that well-funded Chinese companies will swoop in to grab new ideas for their own drug development are shaping an industry unaccustomed to such secrecy.
item.dc:creator: Gina Kolata
item.media:description: Fears that Chinese companies will seize on biotech discoveries in the U.S. and quickly beat them to market with their own inventions or slightly altered dupes have prompted American companies to keep their discoveries secret.

item.title: How the Measles Virus Makes Your Immune System Forget
item.description: The United States is losing its measles-elimination status, signaling the return of a virus that can cause lasting health consequences.
item.dc:creator: David Quammen

item.title: Scientists Are Stumped by This Strange Object in Space
item.description: The rocky body called 1998 KY26 is moving in ways that gravity alone cannot explain. So far, no one knows why.

item.title: How to Watch the 2026 Leonids Meteor Shower

item.title: SpaceX Makes History With Successful Rocket Catch in Texas

item.dc:creator: Kenneth Chang
item.media:description: SpaceX’s Starship successfully returned from orbit and was captured on the launchpad on Saturday afternoon in Starbase, Texas.

item.title: Highlights From the Starship Landing
item.description: The Starship spacecraft safely landed back at the Starbase launch facility, a major step in SpaceX’s quest to build fully reusable rockets.
item.dc:creator: The New York Times
item.media:description: Sunrise at Starbase in Texas on Friday.
